findings.title: Config comment still reads as if the S1192 suppression is in effect on pgTAP suites and fixtures
findings.evidence: .sonarcloud.properties:29-30 says 'Every issue rule except plsql:S1192 (entry e3 below) stays active on them.' That states as current fact that S1192 is inactive on test SQL. findings.title: No contract test pins the ci aggregator's 11-job needs list (pre-existing gap)
findings.evidence: Mutation M4: deleting '- build' from ci.needs (.github/workflows/ci.yml:358-369) left all 21 node tests and all 38 vitest ci.yml contract tests green. Only a structural YAML comparison detects it, plus at runtime the ci job's '[ "$BUILD_RESULT" != "success" ]' check would fail closed. This PR doesn't change ci.needs (0 job-level field diffs against base 084b48c5), and the PR body already lists this as an optional follow-up.
findings.suggested_fix: Follow-up: add a test asserting the exact ci.needs list, and test.needs == ovd591-qualification, from parsed YAML.

findings.title: The composite-action wiring has no local lint/test coverage; only hosted CI proves it
findings.evidence: Mutation M5: pointing 'uses:' at the nonexistent ./.github/actions/setup-root-deps still passes actionlint 1.7.12 (exit 0) and every contract test. actionlint does catch corrupted action metadata (M6, exit 1). The wiring is proven only by hosted logs, e.g. lint job 111468605409: 'Run ./.github/actions/setup-root-dependencies' -> setup-node@v4 -> 'Run npm ci --ignore-scripts' -> nested post step. The PR's 'actionlint pass' claim is true, but it is weak evidence for this piece.
findings.suggested_fix: Optional: a contract test asserting that lint, typecheck, test and build each use ./.github/actions/setup-root-dependencies and that its action.yml exists and runs 'npm ci --ignore-scripts'.

findings.title: The Playwright cache gives only a marginal win, because CI never launches the cached Chromium
findings.evidence: Every CI launch site selects channel 'chrome' when CI=true (playwright.config.ts:19 and the other configs). The 249 MB restored Chromium only saves the existing install step's download: a hit saves about 4-6 s per job, and a miss costs about 5 s to save (job 111468769792, Post Cache Playwright browsers took 5 s). This is disclosed in the PR and comment 5981787840. The CodeRabbit thread was resolved with an owner-decision disposition, because removing the cache would change Linear AC1 and the #445 lane contract (scripts/playwright-lane-config.test.mjs:190-191).
findings.suggested_fix: Owner decision, already recorded: switch to 'install-deps chromium' and drop the cache in a follow-up that updates AC1 and the lane contract.

findings.title: Collapsed e3 widens the S1192 ignore to all 225 supabase SQL files, while repo history says such entries are ignored
findings.evidence: .sonarcloud.properties:51 'e3.resourceKey=supabase/**/*.sql' replaces 7/15 exact-file entries and would cover all future migrations (verified: 133 migrations, 54 tests, 38 fixtures). The prior attempts in #484, #491, #530, #533 and #536 were all recorded as ineffective under Automatic Analysis, so e3 is probably dead config. If it ever did take effect, it would suppress S1192 on new SQL without per-finding review. This matches Linear AC2 ('per-file S1192 entries collapsed') and is documented openly with a post-merge check (docs/engineering-inbox.md:410-422).
findings.suggested_fix: Keep the recorded post-merge check; if main's analysis does not close the existing S1192 issues, delete e3 as the docs already instruct.
